unsupported_or_exception_case: Any of 13 classes unassessed, incomplete, indeterminate or conflicting
required_evidence_or_action: Require signed class agent finding with actual test/source evidence

unsupported_or_exception_case: Only CLP or GHS classification supplied
required_evidence_or_action: Obtain ADR evidence via specialist; no CLP-to-ADR conversion

unsupported_or_exception_case: Subtype self-reactive/desensitized/pyrophoric not assessed
required_evidence_or_action: Obtain type-specific positive or supported negative finding

unsupported_or_exception_case: Radioactive excepted package, SP290 or UN3507 applicability ambiguous
required_evidence_or_action: Require official SP290 applicability and radioactivity record

unsupported_or_exception_case: Inhalation PGI with corrosive property but no carveout assessment
required_evidence_or_action: Obtain route-specific classification and carveout evidence

unsupported_or_exception_case: 6.1 hazard route unknown or unsupported
required_evidence_or_action: Get inhalation/oral/dermal classification basis

unsupported_or_exception_case: Table cell varies by liquid vs solid, physical state missing
required_evidence_or_action: Determine ADR physical state and cite measurement method

unsupported_or_exception_case: Pesticide applicability not assessed on starred cell
required_evidence_or_action: Require evidenced pesticide status

unsupported_or_exception_case: PG unknown for an ordinary matrix axis
required_evidence_or_action: Request specialist PG evidence; no PG inference

unsupported_or_exception_case: Matrix intersection absent from normalized table or unparseable
required_evidence_or_action: Regulatory matrix review by qualified reviewer

unsupported_or_exception_case: More than five simultaneous matrix candidates
required_evidence_or_action: Manual cross-hazard review, extend tested deterministic algorithm

unsupported_or_exception_case: 3+ hazards fold in different orders to inconsistent results
required_evidence_or_action: Independent specialist decision; never silently resolve

unsupported_or_exception_case: Waste composition uncertain or majority hazard unproven
required_evidence_or_action: Dedicated waste rule and human review

unsupported_or_exception_case: Oxidizing material may exhibit explosive properties
required_evidence_or_action: Specialist Class 1/5.1 gate; no automatic carriage authorisation

unsupported_or_exception_case: Articles containing dangerous goods with independent precedence rules
required_evidence_or_action: Dedicated article precedence decision path required

unsupported_or_exception_case: Named substance reveals newly identified hazard
required_evidence_or_action: Competent-authority conditions/approval

unsupported_or_exception_case: Named-entry or named-mixture override not evidenced
required_evidence_or_action: Agent4 unique selection; exact ADR exception and evidence

unsupported_or_exception_case: No complete screening of named vs generic entries
required_evidence_or_action: Agent4 and Agent1 candidate-set completeness

unsupported_or_exception_case: Row not verified against actual source/edition/corrigenda
required_evidence_or_action: Agent1 exact row id, source locator and reviewed columns

unsupported_or_exception_case: Primary differs from selected Table A class
required_evidence_or_action: Preserve conflict; no overwrite

unsupported_or_exception_case: Candidate PG clashes with matrix or selected Table A PG
required_evidence_or_action: Independent PG reconciliation, do not manufacture PG

unsupported_or_exception_case: Table A packing group blank or non-numeric
required_evidence_or_action: Review no-PG entry/requirements, never assign I-II-III without source

unsupported_or_exception_case: Subsidiary labels differ from verified selected row
required_evidence_or_action: Review every criterion and exact column5 label cell

unsupported_or_exception_case: SP code set incomplete or effect unresolved
required_evidence_or_action: Agent1/4 verify all row-linked full text and evidence

unsupported_or_exception_case: Environmental hazard only as additional risk cannot be identified or marked from this subsystem
required_evidence_or_action: Class9/Section14 environmental specialist integration

unsupported_or_exception_case: Sample of untested or partially tested goods
required_evidence_or_action: Sample-specific classification pathway and authority review

unsupported_or_exception_case: Corrigenda unmatched to selected row
required_evidence_or_action: Agent1 source and English corrigenda impact review

unsupported_or_exception_case: Absolute-precedence class without numeric PG
required_evidence_or_action: Use null PG if TableA confirms blank, never create PG

unsupported_or_exception_case: All hazard classes explicitly negative but no independently verified full scope
required_evidence_or_action: Separate Lead negative finding and approval gate

unsupported_or_exception_case: Classification reconciled but no independent regulatory validation
required_evidence_or_action: publishable=false always; external approved release workflow required
